slug.label: Slug
slug.tooltip: Unique URL-friendly identifier. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

email.label: Email
email.tooltip: Email address used to sign in to your account.

password.label: Password
password.tooltip: Account password. Must be at least 6 characters.

locale.label: Locale
locale.tooltip: Language of this translation. Each locale can appear only once per record.

description.label: Description
description.tooltip: Longer summary in the selected language. Used on your profile and CV.

translation.label: Translation
translation.tooltip: Localized content for this record. Add one entry per supported language.

link.label: Link
link.tooltip: Named links such as website, portfolio, or demo URLs.

image.label: Image
image.tooltip: Optional image URL illustrating this entry.

skills.label: Skills
skills.tooltip: Skills from the catalog linked to this record. Order matters where the list is draggable.

relevance.label: Relevance
relevance.tooltip: Score from 1 to 5. Higher values appear more prominently on your CV.

period.label: Period
period.tooltip: Start and end dates. Leave the end date empty if still ongoing.

hours.label: Hours
hours.tooltip: Total workload or duration in hours.

url.label: URL
url.tooltip: Optional public URL for verification or reference.

organization.label: Organization
organization.tooltip: Employer, school, or platform from the Organizations catalog.

level.label: Level
level.tooltip: Academic level of this education entry.

status.label: Status
status.tooltip: Whether this course or education is completed, in progress, or planned.

role.label: Role
role.tooltip: A position held within this experience. Add more than one if you changed roles at the same organization.

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.tooltip: Which API actions this token is allowed to perform.

expiresAtOptional.label: Expires at (optional)
expiresAtOptional.tooltip: Optional expiration date. The token stops working after this date.

logo.label: Logo
logo.tooltip: Optional logo image URL for this organization.

website.label: Website
website.tooltip: Optional website URL for this organization.

birthDate.label: Birth date
birthDate.tooltip: Optional birth date for your profile.

avatarUrl.label: Avatar URL
avatarUrl.tooltip: Optional image URL for your profile photo.

newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.tooltip: Leave blank to keep your current password. Minimum 8 characters when set.

profileName.label: Name
profileName.tooltip: Your full professional name as it should appear on your CV.

organizationName.label: Name
organizationName.tooltip: Public name of the organization as shown in pickers and on your CV.

apiTokenName.label: Name
apiTokenName.tooltip: Friendly label to recognize this token in the list later.

skillCategory.label: Category
skillCategory.tooltip: Optional grouping shown on your CV when skills are listed by category.

organizationCategory.label: Category
organizationCategory.tooltip: Type of organization, such as company, school, or platform.

experienceCategory.label: Category
experienceCategory.tooltip: Engagement type such as full-time, part-time, freelance, or volunteer.

profileTitle.label: Title
profileTitle.tooltip: Display title in the selected language.

experienceTitle.label: Title

educationTitle.label: Title
educationTitle.tooltip: Display title in the selected language.

courseTitle.label: Title

courseTitle.tooltip: Display title in the selected language.

projectTitle.label: Title
projectTitle.tooltip: Display title in the selected language.

translations.tooltip: Localized title and description for this record. Add one entry per supported language.

images.label: Images
images.tooltip: Optional image URLs illustrating this project.

links.label: Links
links.tooltip: Named links such as website, portfolio, or demo URLs.

title.label: Roles
title.tooltip: Positions held within this experience. Add more than one if you changed roles at the same organization.

translations.label: Translations
translations.tooltip: Localized title and description for this role in each supported language.

changeCategory.label: Change Category
changeCategory.tooltip: When checked, updates the category on all selected records.

changeLevel.label: Change Level
changeLevel.tooltip: When checked, updates the level on all selected educations.

changeStatus.label: Change Status
changeStatus.tooltip: When checked, updates the status on all selected records.

changeRelevance.label: Change Relevance
changeRelevance.tooltip: When checked, updates the relevance score on all selected records.

changePermissions.label: Change Permissions
changePermissions.tooltip: When checked, replaces permissions on all selected tokens.
